subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **later**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Later: **at a time in the near future; soon or afterward.
 
• **Before: **earlier than somebody/something.
 
• **Latter: ** the second of two people, things, or groups previously mentioned.
 
• **Earlier: **happen
